caption: The drawing depicts a single glass vessel, likely a goblet or ornate drinking glass, centrally placed on a plain background. The glass is transparent and colorless, illustrated using fine pencil shading and line work which creates the illusion of transparency and reflection. The vessel features a wide, round base with concentric circular ridges, a thick stem with a bulbous central segment, and a broad, curving bowl that narrows at the neck and widens at the rim. On one side, an elegantly curved handle extends from the upper part of the bowl and attaches at the lower neck, with delicate contours and shading emphasizing its three-dimensional form. The background is pale, and the shading throughout the drawing is delicate, with variations in tone to indicate the light passing through and reflecting on the glass surface. There is a faint inscription "JOHN DANA" in small, light letters at the lower left. No other objects or details are present in the composition.
title: Mug
